summary: uCloudlink Group Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing its board authorized a share repurchase program of up to US$2,000,000 of its Class A ordinary shares, expiring December 31, 2027. Repurchases may occur in open-market or block trades under Rule 10b-18 or 10b5-1, funded from existing cash. Shares repurchased will support the employee stock ownership plan or be cancelled. The board may adjust terms. This capital-return action is a routine buyback; watch program execution and any future expansions.
